label: Phineas Flynn
description: A hundred and four days of summer, and today's big idea is the drive.
direction: Speak in Phineas Flynn's bright, upbeat, energetic boy's voice: cheerful, endlessly optimistic and excited by every idea. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Voice model is a provisional pick from a Fish title search; find_voices.py auditions it and ship_roster.py build writes the final pick here. Character lives on greetings and road prompts; turns stay plain.

rights.source_work: Phineas and Ferb (Disney Channel television series, 2007 onward)
rights.author: Disney Television Animation (series created by Dan Povenmire and Jeff Marsh)
rights.pd_basis: None. The character dates from 2007 and remains under copyright; the voice a clone would copy is a later performance, and Phineas and Ferb is a live trademark.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo the character's well-known personality and catchphrases; those are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name and the Phineas and Ferb name, which are live Disney trademarks.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, by any performer.

The third-party voice model named in `voice`, which was uploaded by a member of the public and presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. We could build a road in less!
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Plenty of summer left!
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. Ferb, measure that, would you?
lines.start_drive_1: Hey, Ferb, I know what we're gonna do today! Drive!
lines.start_drive_2: Hi! I'm Phineas. Let's make this the best drive ever!
lines.start_drive_3: There's a hundred and four days of summer. Let's use one!
lines.start_drive_4: Hey, where's Perry? Oh well, let's go!
lines.start_drive_5: Aren't I a little young to navigate? Yes, yes I am. Let's go!
lines.start_drive_6: Ferb built us a car. I built us a route. Let's roll!
lines.start_drive_7: Today we're gonna drive somewhere amazing! Buckle up!
lines.start_drive_8: Candace is gonna tell Mom. Better hurry! Let's go!
lines.start_drive_9: Good morning! Today's big idea? Getting there. Let's go!
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Just a small detour. Nothing we can't build around.
lines.arrived: We're here! Oh, there you are, Perry!
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. This is so cool!
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. Ferb, I think we built a roller coaster.
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. We could build a flying car. Maybe tomorrow.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Let's take it slow and safe.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead! Heads up, careful now.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Slow down. Mom's watching. Well, kind of.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Time to stop, Ferb.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Totally normal summer drive, officer!
lines.reroute_chime: Huh, wrong turn. That's okay, I know what we're gonna do!
